releases.headline: Elesium Deploys Air-Gapped Sovereign vLLM Infrastructure for Indian Commercial Banks Under RBI Cyber Security Framework
releases.summary: Elesium Digital Systems announces production deployment of air-gapped private vLLM clusters for Indian commercial banks complying with RBI Cyber Security Framework Annex II.

releases.headline: Elesium Implements Deterministic Cryptographic Memory Zeroization in Enterprise AI Systems to Enforce DPDP Act 2023 Section 8(5)
releases.summary: Elesium implements hardware-enforced 7-pass memory zeroization across inference KV-cache blocks, guaranteeing statutory DPDP Act compliance.

releases.headline: Elesium Releases Audited Indian Sovereign AI Inference Benchmarks: 148ms TTFT on 8x NVIDIA H100 SXM5 Clusters
releases.summary: Independent benchmark audit confirms 148ms TTFT and 1,403.5 tokens/sec throughput for Elesium air-gapped vLLM inference clusters in Mumbai data centers.
